title: Python ML: AUC - ROC Curve
description: The ROC curve (Receiver Operating Characteristic curve) is a graph showing the performance of a classification model at all classification thresholds. AUC (Area Under the ROC Curve) measures the entire two-dimensional area underneath the entire ROC curve from (0,0) to (1,1). It provides an aggregate measure of performance across all possible classification thresholds.
example:
// ROC Curve with Scikit-learn
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn import metrics

y = [0, 0, 1, 1]
scores = [0.1, 0.4, 0.35, 0.8]
fpr, tpr, thresholds = metrics.roc_curve(y, scores)
roc_auc = metrics.auc(fpr, tpr)

display = metrics.RocCurveDisplay(fpr=fpr, tpr=tpr, roc_auc=roc_auc)
display.plot()
plt.show()
